creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Adding a source of skills written for plain Claude Code (not for tai), `tai install default --dry-run` aborted:

```
processing template in mcp-reference.md: parsing template: [Error (where: lexer) in <string> | Line 75 Col 44] Newline not permitted in a single-line comment.
```

Line 75 is an ordinary markdown heading with an anchor:

```
## Remote transport - `--listen` reference {#remote-transport}
```

pongo2 reads `{#` as a comment opener, finds no `#}`, and that one line fails the whole profile install, 95 unrelated assets included. The workaround was scanning all 17 of the source's skills for template sigils, then a patch that wraps the anchor in `{% verbatim %}` and has to be re-blessed against every upstream release.

Heading anchors are common in markdown, so any third-party skill source can hit this.

Suggested:

- A way for a source or an asset to opt out of templating (`template: false` on the source in tai.yaml, or per asset).
- And/or: a template parse error in a source tai doesn't own becomes a skip-with-warning (install that file untemplated, or skip the asset) instead of failing the install.

(Moved from GitHub issue #10.)
title: A template parse error in one third-party file fails the whole install
